title: 第二十二章 不知天高地厚第二十三章 物理教授
lines: 第二十二章不知天高地厚
陶燕俊犹豫了，她才给王恩伦打过电话，再打过去，说不定对方就不耐烦了。
她毕竟不是她堂哥陶沐风，不能一个电话就让人马首是瞻。
“你等一下，我已经给王叔打过电话了，他的人很快就会过来。”
陶燕俊也只有先把飞哥稳住，祈祷着王叔的人早点来。
“半个小时，王老大的人来了我就放人，要是来不了，你们一个也走不了！”
飞哥总算是忌惮王恩伦的势力，不敢轻易动手。
陶燕俊也松了一口气，随后又紧张起来，祈祷王叔安排的人马早点到。
“那可不行，我还要坐车去林城呢，你们快点道歉。”
这个时候，叶欢那个风轻云淡地声音又想起了，让陶燕俊的心瞬间沉了下去。
这个不知死活的家伙！
“陈晨，我们走，别管这个不知死活的家伙……”
陶燕俊暴怒，这个家伙简直是个傻瓜，已经一定发了疯才会想要救他！
在路过叶欢身边的时候，有听到这个家伙不咸不淡的一句：“早就该离开了，耽搁我这么多时间。”
陶燕俊差点一口老血喷了出来，这个人——真的是个疯子！
“小妞，现在就想走啊，哪有这么容易。”一个小混混却拦住了陶燕俊的去路，不让她和陈晨上车。
“我说，能不能快一点，你们已经耽误我很长时间了。”
叶欢早就不耐烦了，要不是两个女孩下来，他才懒得和一群混混BB半天。
这种垃圾，真的没有和他说话的资格！
“一起上吧！”叶欢声音冰冷。
一群混混还没有反应过来，叶欢便动了，一拳率先打在一旁的一个混混身上，几颗带血的牙齿就飞了出来。
“干死他！”
飞哥最先反应过来，提着砍刀就冲了上来。
不管陶燕俊来自什么家族，受过什么教育，到底也只是一个女孩子，哪里见过这么暴力危险的一幕。
两人躲到一旁，陶燕俊抱着陈晨，相比之下，她还是要更镇定一些。
接近500个特种兵都不是叶欢的对手，何况十几个小混混。
几乎是一眨眼的功夫，这些人就被叶欢撂倒在地上，痛苦地呻吟着。
叶欢没有和这些垃圾说一句话的心思都没有，上去就是一人一脚，把他们的腿骨给踢断了。
十几个混混痛苦地大叫着，场面极其混乱。
车上的乘客都不可思议的看着这一幕，这个年轻人，太暴力了！
到底谁才是黑社会？
轮到飞哥了，他身体素质好点，挣扎着跪了起来。
“大哥，我错了，我错了，我给你跪下磕头道歉了，你就放过我吧……”
他真的是被吓死了，叶欢暴力了，一人一脚，把人腿踢断的时候眼睛都不眨一下。

Chapter 22 I don’t know how high the sky is and how high it is
Tao Yanjun hesitated before she called Wang Enlun. If she called again, the other party might become impatient.
After all, she is not her cousin Tao Mufeng, and she can't make people follow him with just a phone call.
"Wait a minute, I've already called Uncle Wang, and his people will be here soon."
Tao Yanjun could only stabilize Brother Fei first and pray that Uncle Wang's people would come soon.
"In half an hour, I will let Boss Wang's people come. If they don't come, none of you will be able to leave!"
Brother Fei was finally afraid of Wang Enlun's power and did not dare to take action easily.
Tao Yanjun also breathed a sigh of relief, and then became nervous again, praying that the people arranged by Uncle Wang would arrive soon.
"That's not possible. I have to take a bus to Lincheng. Please apologize quickly."
At this time, Ye Huan's calm voice came back to mind, making Tao Yanjun's heart sink instantly.
This guy who doesn’t know how to live or die!
"Chen Chen, let's go, don't worry about this guy who doesn't know how to live or die..."
Tao Yanjun was furious. This guy is simply a fool. He must have gone crazy to want to save him!
When passing by Ye Huan, I heard this guy say something salty but not cool: "It's time to leave a long time ago, it took me so much time."
Tao Yanjun almost spit out a mouthful of old blood. This man - is really a madman!
"Girl, I want to leave now. It's not that easy." A gangster blocked Tao Yanjun's way and prevented her and Chen Chen from getting in the car.
"I said, can you hurry up? You have delayed me for a long time."
Ye Huan has long been impatient. If the two girls hadn't come down, he wouldn't have bothered to hang out with a group of gangsters for a long time.
This kind of rubbish really has no qualifications to talk to him!
"Let's go together!" Ye Huan's voice was cold.
Before the group of gangsters could react, Ye Huan moved and punched a gangster nearby, causing several bloody teeth to fly out.
"Fuck him!"
Fei Ge was the first to react and rushed forward with a machete.
No matter what family Tao Yanjun came from or what education he received, she was still just a girl. She had never seen such a violent and dangerous scene.
The two of them hid aside. Tao Yanjun was holding Chen Chen. In comparison, she was still calmer.
Nearly 500 special forces soldiers were no match for Ye Huan, let alone a dozen gangsters.
Almost in the blink of an eye, these people were thrown to the ground by Ye Huan, groaning in pain.
Ye Huan had no intention of saying a word to these rubbish. He went up and kicked them one by one, breaking their leg bones.
"Ah!"
A dozen gangsters screamed in pain, and the scene was extremely chaotic.
The passengers in the car looked at this scene in disbelief. This young man was so violent!
Who is the underworld?
It was Brother Fei's turn. He was in better shape and struggled to kneel down.
"Brother, I was wrong, I was wrong. I knelt down and kowtowed to you to apologize. Just let me go..."
He was really frightened to death. Ye Huan was violent. He kicked one person at a time and broke his legs without even blinking.
